units.source_text: 夫人的话有些尖刻，但绝不到刺耳的程度。

en.t: Her words were somewhat sharp, but by no means so harsh as to grate on the ear.

units.source_text: 夫人不是现代人，因而才会通过显示自己是个有头脑的人，寻求某种自尊。

en.t: Because she was not a modern person, she sought a certain self-respect by showing that she was someone with intelligence.

units.source_text: 比起争论来，夫人似乎更珍视内心深处的安宁。

en.t: Rather than argument, she seemed to value the peace deep within her heart more.
